notes.notes:
Hello dear reader,

We hope you are ready to travel through the strangest National Park you have ever seen!

Great North Shelter will open to visitors on August 31 at 8 A.M. PDT.

notes.title: GNS2 Demo, Update 2 - Photo Mode
notes.notes:
Photo Mode is finally available and now you can take beautiful screenshots using many different settings.

You can enter Photo Mode from the pause menu while in-game.
